purpose: Gameplay and economy-facing combat catalog. This file intentionally excludes art paths, icon filenames, palettes, and visual-production prompts; those live in Design/VisualConfigs/WarlineCapture_Combat_Visual_Config_v0_1.json.

tierModel.paidUpgradeRule: Store grants may provide BlueprintParts or resources but upgrades are applied only through UpgradeService and never inside active combat.

abilities.effect: Consumes one Aid Convoy to improve Operation Trust through authored district actions.

availability.precondition: Owned Aid Convoy supply and selected district with aid action available.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Unlock Persistent Operation.

abilities.effect: Deals high structure damage to one wall, gate, or fortified objective after an arm time.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, valid wall/gate/fortified target, and Materials cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 3 Breach Charge reward.

abilities.effect: Reduces post-mission own-unit casualty consequence for a selected squad if they survive extraction.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, friendly infantry squad alive, and Materials cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 2 Medical Support reward.

abilities.effect: Reveals enemy route, composition hint, and one hidden objective marker in the scan radius.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, valid scan area, and Intel cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 3 Drone Scan reward.

abilities.effect: Marks a protected extraction route that improves civilian/infantry movement and reduces panic penalties.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, valid extraction/road route, and Fuel cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn reward.ch01.m04.support_unlock.

abilities.effect: Repairs a damaged vehicle or building over eight seconds; interrupted by direct damage.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, damaged friendly vehicle/building, and Materials cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 2 Field Repair reward.

abilities.effect: Sea unit patrols a water lane and delays naval/port threats.

availability.precondition: Selected sea unit and valid water lane/harbor zone.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Reach Chapter 4 coastal mission.

abilities.effect: Reveals hidden water-lane threats and port objective risks.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, valid water lane/harbor zone, and Intel cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 4 Harbor Scan reward.

abilities.effect: Sea unit fires on a visible coastal fortification or armored group inside naval support range.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, visible coastal target, sea support range, and Fuel cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 4 Naval Fire Support reward.

abilities.effect: Converts coastal logistics into OperationSupply through authored Operation actions.

availability.precondition: Owned dock/coastal logistics access and selected district supply-route action.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 4 Supply Route reward.

abilities.effect: Air unit strikes one visible armored or fortified target; cannot hit hidden targets or mission objectives until revealed.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, visible enemy vehicle/building target, and Fuel cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 4 Precision Strike reward.

abilities.effect: Queues an allowed unit from the building production list using unit cost and production time.

availability.precondition: Selected/owned producer building, allowed production unit, queue capacity, and resource cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Reach M02 Establish The Base.

abilities.effect: Refreshes ground/air threat ETA and direction for detected enemies.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, radar/sensor unit or building active, mission allows threat warning refresh.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn reward.ch01.m03.radar_ping_unlock.

abilities.effect: Newly produced units path to the selected rally socket for the rest of the mission.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, friendly producer/Command Post, and valid rally socket.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 5 Rally Order reward.

abilities.effect: Shortens an Operation timer or improves next-day readiness; never affects active combat cooldowns.

availability.precondition: Owned readiness supply or Rush Ticket and selected Operation timer/readiness action.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Unlock Persistent Operation.

abilities.effect: Consumes one Repair Convoy to improve Operation Infrastructure through authored district actions.

availability.precondition: Owned Repair Convoy supply and selected district with infrastructure damage.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 2 Repair Convoy path.

abilities.effect: Temporarily reduces incoming ranged accuracy for units inside the smoke area.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, selected vehicle or map area, and Fuel cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 4 Smoke Screen reward.

abilities.effect: Adds a small tactical Credits/Materials cache at a secured drop zone.

availability.precondition: Owned support ability, secured drop zone, and Fuel cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Earn Chapter 5 Supply Drop reward.

abilities.effect: Order selected combat units to attack a unit, building, wall, or breach target.

availability.precondition: Selected combat-capable units with a visible enemy unit/building/wall/gate target.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: DisabledReason: Select combat-capable units and a visible target.

abilities.effect: Attack the nearest valid wall or gate before entering an enemy base perimeter.

availability.precondition: Selected combat-capable units and one marked wall/gate breach target.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Reach M05 Breach Assault.

abilities.effect: Selected units prioritize one target for ten seconds.

availability.precondition: Selected combat-capable units and one visible priority target.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Complete M05 Breach Assault command tutorial.

abilities.effect: Units defend in place and do not chase beyond aggro range.

availability.precondition: Selected controllable combat units.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Complete M03 Radar Warning command tutorial.

abilities.effect: Board eligible nearby infantry into a selected transport.

availability.precondition: Selected transport with free capacity and eligible nearby infantry.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: DisabledReason: Select a transport with free capacity near eligible infantry.

abilities.effect: Move selected units to a reachable position.

availability.precondition: Selected controllable units with a reachable target cell.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: DisabledReason: Select a controllable unit and choose a reachable cell.

abilities.effect: Transport helicopter deploys loaded infantry by rope at a valid landing zone.

availability.precondition: Selected loaded transport helicopter, valid landing/drop zone, and Fuel cost paid.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: Locked: Reach M04 Airlift transport tutorial.

abilities.effect: Clear active move/attack orders and hold current position.

availability.precondition: Selected controllable units.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: DisabledReason: Select a controllable unit.

abilities.effect: Disembark passengers at a valid cell or landing zone.

availability.precondition: Selected loaded transport and valid drop cell or landing zone.
availability.lockedOrDisabledState: DisabledReason: Select a loaded transport and valid drop zone.
